title: VA Home Loan Guaranty Terms for Refunding a Funding Fee
content:
These are the terms on which a funding fee paid on a VA Home Loan Guaranty loan is refunded.

**(a) Grounds.** A funding fee is refunded when the loan's exemption has been recognized after closing (a retroactive compensation award, or a Purple Heart received after closing) or the fee was collected in error.

**(b) Condition on the loan record.** A refund is issued only when the loan record shows the veteran as exempt from the funding fee. The loan record of the loan on which the fee was charged is the authority, as it stands before the refund is booked.

**(c) Amount and payment.** The clause "The refund equals the full fee collected on that loan, is paid by VA directly to the veteran" is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis for figuring the refund paid on a funding fee charge.

**(d) Once per charge.** Each funding fee charge is refunded only once. A funding fee charge that already has a refund entry tied to it in the loan's money transactions is not refunded again.

**(e) Loans since closed.** A fee on a loan the veteran has since paid off or refinanced is still refundable.

The program terms on refunds after a retroactive award and on the refund method are program figures of the VA Home Loan Guaranty.

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Hypothetical loan | Loan record shows exempt | Charge already carries a refund entry | Refund issued |
|---|---|---|---|
| Loan paid off two years ago; exemption recognized after closing | Yes | No | Yes, (e) keeps it refundable |
| Active loan; second request on the same charge | Yes | Yes | No, (d) |
| Active loan; record does not show the veteran exempt | No | No | No, (b) |

superseded_clauses: The refund equals the full fee collected on that loan, is paid by VA directly to the veteran
